evidence_snippets: Dialogflow provides predefined system entities that can match many common types of data.

The following diagram shows the basic flow for intent matching and responding to the end-user: Entities Each intent parameter has a type, called the entity type , which dictates exactly how data from an end-user expression is extracted.
When an intent is matched, Dialogflow provides the action to your system, and you can use the action to trigger certain actions defined in your system.
